sinopsis.es: Cuando Mila le dice que está con otra persona, Adam se refugia en recuerdos y fantasías. Intenta aferrarse a un amor que nunca terminó de comprender.
sinopsis.en: When Mila tells him she’s seeing someone else, Adam’s world collapses. He drifts through his memories and fantasies, trying to hold on to a love he never truly knew how to see, and which now slips away from him.
